page.overview:
Who is Dominic?

Dominic is a major character in Gumdrop Angel, the first story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. He is the young assistant manager of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza who meets Angel during her step-sister's birthday party.

Dominic is a cute and attractive young man. He's slightly taller than Angel and has broad shoulders, narrow hips, and is fit. Dominic also has dark hair, dark eyes, and strong features.

Dominic is charming and friendly. As an assistant manager, he makes sure that the customers are happy, and he does so by treating them with respect and demonstrating his kind, gentle nature. Dominic's also shown to be rather intelligent, constantly telling clever yet cheesy jokes and having a great memory. However, due to his cooperation with the horrific transformation of young girls into gumdrop statues and him winking at Angel as Ophelia's Birthday Gummy is being revealed, he may possess a rather sadistic side. Still, Dominic is shown to care about Angel and is remorseful when he learns she had eaten the gumdrop nose.

Dominic works part-time as an assistant manager at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza while also attending Graves Academy, a private school for intelligent kids. Due to his position, he is aware of the horrific truth behind the birthday gummies and helps prepare them for birthdays.
